actions.action: Before each paid request, resolve the current completed XHKG target session and run fresh strict preflight, price integrity, frozen native exact-session smoke and official-tokenizer cost proof.
If all request-before-send gates pass and no duplicate/concurrent candidate exists, create a new independent Claim and send at most one DeepSeek request for that sample.
Persist raw evidence privately to Drive, verify save/read/hash/restore, run semantic gates and manual scoped review. Preserve failures immutably.

On failure, perform model-free root-cause diagnosis and regression repair before consuming another request. If the same root-cause class persists across two paid samples, pause paid requests and reassess architecture.

stop_immediately_if: CNY 1.00 batch hard cap reached or cannot be proven safe before send
same root-cause class persists across two paid samples
